operator_observation: The ACO02B speech was audible from the external speakers but barely audible to the operator.

defects_and_corrections.defect: Preflight accepted any knob level at or below 50 percent, including a level too quiet to reproduce the frozen operating point.
defects_and_corrections.correction: Acceptance now requires a fresh operator confirmation that the mechanical knob is at approximately 50 percent. The stored manifest defaults that confirmation to false.

defects_and_corrections.defect: The normalizer assumed a salient workload key and raised KeyError on a zero-salience completed run.
defects_and_corrections.correction: Zero-salience runs now normalize to an explicit failed salient-latency criterion while preserving raw telemetry.

defects_and_corrections.defect: PortAudio omitted built-in outputs from its enumeration while the XVF3800 was connected.
defects_and_corrections.correction: Read-only preflight now uses macOS CoreAudio inventory for named output presence and PortAudio only for XVF input-format support.

retry_boundary: A corrected run is permitted only after restoring the already-frozen approximate-50-percent mechanical knob position and setting the fresh manifest confirmation true. Digital gain, saliency threshold, geometry, stimulus, frame count, and all acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
claim_boundary: This is a retained engineering acceptance failure and defect correction record, not a scientific result or promotion.
